recipes.name: Gado Gado on Toast
instructions: To a large pan over medium-high heat, add the oil and slices of bread. Toast the bread until golden on both sides.
Top the toast with peanut butter, cucumber, carrot, ketjap, sambal, and fried shallots. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Ketjap manis is a sweetened Indonesian soy sauce with a thick, syrupy texture and rich, sweet flavour. Made from fermented soybeans, sugar, garlic, and spices, it has a complex, aromatic taste. Find it at your local Asian grocery store.
Storage The assembled toast is best when enjoyed immediately.
